name: Check and file a task
description: On a schedule, an agent checks something and answers OK or describes the problem. Only a problem files a Kanban task, and a problem that is still there on the next check adds a line to the same task instead of filing another. Change what to check first.

check.title: What to check
check.description: What the agent looks at, such as: Is the nightly build of acme/site green on its latest run?

target.title: Who gets the task
target.description: The id of the agent the task is for. Leave it empty to put the task in the backlog.
